summary.tldr: Changes Criminal Code penalties for extortion and makes arson an aggravating factor at sentencing.
what_it_does: Changes the penalty for extortion to life in prison when a restricted or prohibited firearm is used, or when the offence is linked to a criminal organization.
Sets the minimum penalty for extortion at 4 years in prison when a different firearm is used, and 3 years in any other case.
Requires courts to treat arson as an aggravating factor when sentencing someone convicted of extortion.
who_it_affects: People who use firearms in extortion
summary.background: The bill amends section 346 of the Criminal Code, which sets penalties for extortion.
